properties.name: database.type
properties.description: Legacy alias for the WCDK fallback driver/schema hint. The new property wins when both are nonblank. Removal planned for 4.0.0.

properties.name: wcdk.r2dbc.database-type
properties.description: Driver hint for the single-source WCDK fallback and schema initializer; does not override Spring Boot or multi-source URL drivers. Blank values fall back to database.type, then the URL/metadata.
